name: web3.py
description: A python interface for interacting with the Ethereum blockchain and ecosystem.

issues.title: Add documentation for `TypedDict` return values of methods usable by 3rd parties
ContractEvent.processLog (and others?) break when used as classmethod
Document how to set up ENS for non-mainnet addresses
AsyncHTTPProvider requests can deadlock HTTPSessionManager._lock when cancelled
Move `get_event_data` and `get_function_info` from web3._utils modules to Public API
Clearer error on contract execution error during call()

latest_release.name: v8.0.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix: logs subscription topics by @fselmo in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3748
* Resolve datetime.datetime.utcnow() deprecation by @mdalp in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3751
* Fix indentation in the docs by @mdalp in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3752
* Ignore too slow healthcheck for test_key_generation_is_deterministic by @mdalp in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3750
* Update link  wiki by @NikolaiKryshnev in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3746
* fixed typo in bugfix description by @viktorking7 in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3755
* Align isort skip path by @Shresth79 in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3756
* Make AsyncWeb3 Generic by @aleexharris in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3761
* Generate fixture for geth v1.16.5 by @fselmo in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3775
* removal: Remove the deprecated LegacyWebSocketProvider by @fselmo in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3762
* Drop Support for Python 3.8 & 3.9 by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3774
* Remove mark on fixture by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3782
* AsyncBeacon: fix AttributeError by using aiohttp.ClientTimeout throughout by @lrusak in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3784
* Upgrade geth to 1.16.7 by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3787
* Add Python 3.14 Support by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3779
* Increase eth-utils dep to 5.3.0+ by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3790
* Fix web3_api test by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3792
* docs: add formatters documentation by @phessophissy in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3798
* Fix TypedDict field names to use camelCase for JSON-RPC consistency by @ilijapet in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3801
* fix: use explicit session for all threads when provided by @madisoncarter1234 in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3800
* Fix mypy CI checks by @kclowes in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3803
* Feat/update ccip read configurations by @fselmo in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3817
* internal: update ensip15 tests and sources by @fselmo in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3815
* fix: restore method/params in WS send-caching dummy request (#3823) by @saheersk in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3825
* feat(ens): use Universal Resolver for ENS resolution by @Dhaiwat10 in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3822
* refactor: move to Github Actions; remove bundled maintainence scripts by @fubuloubu in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3873
* Clean deps by @yabirgb in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3857
* feat(eth): remove deprecated `get_uncle_*` method by @dzhalaevd in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3806
* refactor: remove deprecated function by @fubuloubu in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3876
* fix(ens): remove abi_ens_resolver v8 backwards-compat NameNotFound catch by @genisis0x in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3844
* fix: EIP-7702 auth signature fields were wrong type by @kushdab in https://github.com/ApeWorX/web3.py/pull/3864
